theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+0.97%) and Energy (+0.72%) led the market today, while Materials (-0.91%) and Utilities (-0.72%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.04%, defensives -0.17%, and value/cyclicals -0.16% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.13%, Dow -0.27%, Nasdaq -0.26% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.97%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 6.20% to 16.11, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.70% to $4,288.70, crude oil was little changed at $96.64, and bitcoin gained 0.31% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
